svg.aria-label: Plate VI: seven-petal rosette split copper and gold around a severed factory belt vignette, no-Chevrolets microtext ring
svg.title: Plate VI · The severed belt
svg.desc: Privately issued banknote plate: a seven-petal lathe rosette split copper west and gold east with a dashed green echo on the information side; a central vignette of a stopped drive pulley with a frayed severed belt on the industrial side and a dashed superhighway lane with a node diamond on the information side; a circular microtext ring reading THERE WILL BE NO CHEVROLETS AND NO UAW TO STRIKE; denomination cartouches VI in the four corners.
